title: Kamailio World 2024: Demos And Showcases
html:
During the first day of Kamailio World Conference 2024, a dedicated room will be available for presenting demos and showcases of RTC products and services. Any of the participants to the conference can book a spot for a specific time frame and invite small groups of people to view what they do in the RTC space.

You can read more details on the announcement page.

It is now one month before the next Kamailio World Conference starts in Berlin, Germany (during April 18-19, 2024), the schedule will be published during the next days. Meanwhile you can see the details of the most of the accepted sessions at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com/k2024/schedule/

Looking forward to meeting many of you in Berlin at the next Kamailio World Conference!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
